protocol: Each run rasterizes the same source PDF page before the production DocumentProcessor, then scores four manually reviewed text anchors. Only the named Tesseract page PSM and render scale vary; table OCR remains PSM 3 at 2.5x.
limitations: One page from a historical Shopee seller guide; not a physical scan or representative OCR sample.
Four selected phrase anchors only; no full-page CER/WER or structured-table ground truth.
Single-reviewer anchors do not justify a general OCR model or settings decision.
